description: This file defines the CredentialsMessageFilter class, which provides a static method to verify the validity of credentials API messages based on certain required properties such as message ID, subject, reply-to address, and body content.

classes.name: CredentialsMessageFilter
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to verify credentials messages for correct format and required properties.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Checks whether a given credentials message contains all required properties: message ID or correlation ID, valid subject, reply-to address, and data payload. Returns true if all checks pass.
